subject: Renewal conversation: Dedicated reserved pool + H100 conversion plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation: Dedicated reserved pool + H100 conversion plan

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As Stellar approaches the renewal window, I wanted to put a concise proposal on the table so your procurement and infra teams can review:

Summary ask:
- Convert 40 A100 reserved GPUs to 28 H100 (L40S-capable) reserved slots for the 12-month renewal, with throughput guarantees for 99th-p90 latency on your realtime inference routes.
- Add a 10% burst pool for spiky nightly workloads (on-demand reserved capacity).

Why this helps Stellar now:
- H100 + L40S path gives ~1.8x token throughput on your chat models at the same or lower cost after quantization.
- Reduced per-token inference cost and lower queueing latency on peak traffic windows.

I've attached a short performance/econ workbook (H100_L40S_perf_vs_A100_ppd.xlsx) and a draft SOW amendment for the committed pool. Can we schedule 30 minutes tomorrow to walk procurement through the numbers and target DocuSign timing?

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick sync Wed 10:30am PT with your procurement and infra leads.
2) We'll circulate a revised SOW + amendment within 24 hours after the call.
3) If approved, new hardware conversion and billing take effect at renewal date.

Cheers,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

Alice — thanks, great questions. Short answers up front and a small table below. Attached is the workbook with the model and assumptions.

1) p50/p90 throughput and cost assumptions (representative):
- Current: 40x A100 (baseline) handling your 3k rps mixed chat + longform with p90 latency ~380ms, average tokens per request ~750. Effective per-1k-token cost = $0.045 (model+inference infra).
- Proposal: 28x H100 (L40S-capable) reserved + 10% burst pool. Observed per-batch throughput ~1.8x for same beam/seqlen on our benchmark. Expected p90 latency ~210–260ms, p50 ~80–110ms depending on batchiness. Effective per-1k-token cost = $0.032 after quantized runtime and batching gains.

2) Burst pool behavior:
- 10% burst pool is reserved headroom within your contract that can be autoscaled for short windows. Guaranteed for scaling policy up to burst limit with a short provisioning lead (~30–90s). For hard SLAs during bursts we can add a billed provisioned burst with higher SLOs.

3) Quality delta for L40S-quantized variants:
- For your chat prompts we expect negligible impact when using our Q4 quantization profile (we validate across your prompt set). Typical measured ROUGE/semantic-similarity deltas are <0.6% on our evals; we include a conservative switching window you can test before cutover.

Performance-per-dollar justification (excerpt):
- Baseline per-hour throughput (A100): 140K tokens/hour per GPU
- H100 (L40S) per-hour throughput: 252K tokens/hour per GPU (~1.8x)
- Effective cost per GPU-hour (post-commit pricing): A100 $X, H100 $1.4X (example) -> net cost-per-token goes down given throughput uplift and quantization.

Net impact: ~28%–32% lower effective per-token cost while improving tail latency for interactive routes. Full sensitivity tables in attached workbook.

Next steps: I suggest we run a 7-day pilot conversion on a subset of routes to validate tail latency and quality. If ok, we'll finalize the SOW amendment. Are you available Wed 03/10 for a pilot kickoff?

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: H100_L40S_perf_vs_A100_ppd.xlsx
